name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in processing time, but the 0.5%+ quality gain justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is motion blur, not resolution loss—locking style won’t help motion clarity. Instead, test InstantX-ComfyUI’s temporal-aware upscaler on EXCAVA’s worst motion frames; if it reduces blur by even 1%, it’s worth the slowdown. Settle it with a blind A/B test on 50 motion-heavy clips—no excuses.
